claude_only.name: Which system of record is authoritative for this team's identifier, and what is the key?
If no master-system key exists, which governed IRI or Dimension-minted UUID/ULID is assigned, and by whom?
Which alternate business identifiers must be carried, and which are merely correlational?
When two records are found to describe the same team, which survives and how is the loser tombstoned?
Is this collective an internal unit of one formal organization, a cross-organization collaboration, or a rule-defined cohort?
Is membership enumerated by identified participants or defined by characteristics?
Does the team have any separate legal recognition, and if not, which legal entity bears its obligations?
What disqualifies this record from being a team under this model?
Which controlled classification schemes apply, and what is the code in each?
Is the team standing, time-boxed or incident-activated, and what evidence supports that?
Does the team qualify as a publicly presented department with its own URL, logo or hours?
Against which published typing definition and version does this team claim a tier?
Which capability tier is claimed, and what verified evidence supports the claim?
Where does the current composition fall short of the claimed tier, and what compensating measure applies?
What must a requester agree before this team can be deployed or engaged?
Is there a written constituting statement, who approved it, and when did it take effect?
What is the team's purpose and the specific functions it is expected to perform?
Is any element of the charter mandated by law, regulation or contract rather than chosen?
What objective is the team accountable for, over what period, and how is attainment judged?
When must the charter be reviewed or revalidated, and what triggers an out-of-cycle review?
Which single party is accountable for the team's outcomes, and through which post is that held?
Which organizations manage or co-manage the team, and how are conflicts between them resolved?
Which decisions may the team make autonomously, which need approval, and up to what threshold?
Which combinations of decision rights must not be held by the same person?
Where does the team sit in the reporting structure, and is that line solid or matrixed?
For each member, when did participation start and when did or will it end?
Which system is authoritative for writing membership, and how are conflicting writes from HR and IdP reconciled?
Is a departed member marked inactive with a closed period or removed from the record entirely?
How are backdated or corrected memberships recorded without losing the prior assertion?
Does this member occupy a defined position, or hold only a team-scoped role with no position behind it?
Which governed occupation code describes the work performed, and under which classification version?
May one member hold several roles in the same team at once, and how is that recorded?
Which role carries leadership of the team, and is it the same as the accountable owner?
On whose behalf does each external participant act, and under which contract?
Are any participants software agents, devices or robots, and who is the responsible human principal?
Does the team contain nested sub-teams, and is that permitted by the governing method or policy?
What data may an external participant see, and what is withheld?
What share of each member's working time is committed to this team, and over which period?
Which other teams hold competing claims on the same member, and does the total exceed 1.0 FTE?
During which hours and days is the team required to be staffed?
Is reported capacity a planned commitment or an observed actual, and from which record?
What is the minimum viable composition by role, and what happens when it is not met?
Which constraint profile applies, and is it legally binding, contractual or methodological?
Are there maximum size or nesting limits, and what evidence supports them?
Are there fitness, medical or physical prerequisites for any role in this team?
Which competences does the team's mandate require, expressed in which governed vocabulary?
Which required competences are held by only one active member or by none?
What evidence supports each claimed competence, and who assessed it?
Can the team complete its expected functions without external hand-off, and if not, where does it depend on others?
Which licences, certifications or task-book completions are required for each role in this team?
When does each held credential expire, and what recurrence keeps it current?
Which members are currently lapsed, and are they suspended from the affected duties?
How is a credential verified against the issuing authority rather than self-asserted?
What is the team's current status and since when?
Which status transitions are permitted, and who may authorise each?
How is an erroneously created team distinguished from one that ended normally?
What does suspension mean operationally for memberships, access and obligations?
For each assertion, when did the fact become true and when was it recorded?
Is the local UTC offset known for each timestamp, or must -00:00 be used?
How are open-ended and future-dated periods represented and queried as-of an instant?
What timestamp precision is required, and where is a date alone acceptable?
Who authorised the team's formation and on what instrument?
What condition triggers dissolution, and is it time-based, objective-based or discretionary?
On dissolution, where do open obligations, artifacts and members go?
What entitlements must be revoked on dissolution, and within what window?
Which predecessor teams produced this team, and which successors did it produce?
Does the team retain its identifier through the change, or is a new identity minted?
Are historical metrics and memberships consolidated, split or left with the predecessor?
When a team moves to a different parent unit, what changes and what must not?
Which other teams does this team depend on, and which depend on it?
Through what agreed interface and service expectation does each dependency operate?
What is the authoritative contact route for the team as a whole, distinct from any individual?
Is the team part of a wider standing collaboration, and who convenes it?
Which site is primary for the team, and which secondary sites are in use?
How is the team distributed across sites, jurisdictions and time zones?
Which obligations change because members sit in different jurisdictions?
Are there hours in the required coverage window with no staffed member?
Which metric definition and version is being reported, and who owns it?
Over what window is each value measured, and at what instant was it computed?
Is the value reported at team level, consolidated upward, or suppressed for materiality or re-identification risk?
How are values restated after a merge, split or definition change?
Which agent asserted each team fact, acting on whose behalf and under what plan?
Is each value system-derived, self-reported or audited, and what is its known error?
Which recurring health, safety or training duties attach to this team, and are they current?
What workload or exposure limits apply, and how are breaches detected and escalated?
What would an auditor need to reconstruct a reported team fact end to end?
Which system generated each record, and from which upstream record was it derived?
How is concurrent modification detected and rejected?
What integrity value proves an artifact has not changed since issue?
When a record is corrected, how is the superseded version preserved and located?
What is the default visibility of the team record, and which elements are more restricted?
For what declared purpose is each personal element held, and what use is out of scope?
How long is each class of team record retained, and what starts the clock?
On erasure or objection, which elements are deleted, which anonymised and which must be kept?
When a membership ends, within what window are entitlements revoked and how is that evidenced?
Which external profiles must this team be projected into, and at which versions?
Which fields are lost or distorted in each projection, and how is the loss disclosed?
What evidence supports a conformance claim against a given profile?
Can a projection be reimported without losing identity or membership history?

grok_only.name: What identifier does the authoritative master system assign to this team, and which system is that master?
What governed IRI, SCIM id, FHIR identifier or Dimension UUID or ULID identifies this team when no master identifier is available?
Which external identifiers must remain constant as the team record is updated or propagated between systems?
Is a generated slug, mail nickname or display name being treated as identity despite being derived from a changeable name?
What is the preferred human-readable name of the team, and in which language or locale is it expressed?
What alternative names, generated slugs, mail nicknames or notations exist, and which system derives them from the preferred name?
What description or comment distinguishes this team from similarly named teams, such as red versus green trauma teams?
Who is authorized to change the team name, description or profile picture?
What kind or category of team is this, using the local controlled vocabulary and any aligned standard code?
Which classification scheme or profile constrains allowed kinds, and is the scheme legal-form, service, clinical category or product-method?
Which co-existing categories apply at once, such as longitudinal care team and encounter team, and how are they disambiguated?
Is this team also a legal Organization, as Schema.org SportsTeam may be, or only an OrganizationalUnit with no legal personality?
What specialization, template or method profile applies, and which unique behaviours does it unlock or constrain?
If this is a sports or other domain team, what sport, discipline or domain label applies?
Does an extended gender label, mixed-team flag or class-team setting apply to this team as a whole?
Which operating rules, such as Scrum no-hierarchy or GitHub secret-team no-nesting, are inherited from the chosen profile rather than locally overridden?
What is the defining purpose, remit or Product Goal of this team, independent of who currently belongs to it?
If a coded reason exists, why does the team exist, and to which condition, mission or objective does that reason refer?
Is the stated purpose still valid for the current interval, or has the team been re-purposed without a change event?
Which organization or person authorized this mandate, and under what instrument?
Who or what is the team for: a patient, a group, a product, a sporting competition, or an event that has no subject yet?
Which league, club, sports organization or competition is this sports team a member of?
May this team exist without a subject, as a code-blue or emergency response team, and under what trigger is a subject later bound?
Does this team share a Product Goal, backlog or owner with sibling teams after a size-driven split?
What minimum or maximum size constraint applies, and is it a Scrum typical bound, a local policy or unconstrained?
Is the team self-managing, meaning members decide who does what, when and how, or does an external manager assign work?
Is the whole team collectively accountable for outcomes, or are outcomes split by role, post or reporting line?
Must the team hold all skills needed to create value in one cycle, and which skill gaps are currently accepted?
Which Organization instance contains this team, and is the team a unit with meaning only inside that organization?
Which organization is responsible for managing the team, if that is different from the containing organization?
Which tenant, directory or provisioning domain hosts the team record?
Must every member already belong to the containing organization, as GitHub requires, or may outsiders participate?
For each practitioner or agent, on behalf of which organization do they participate?
Which organizations are members of the team, as opposed to merely managing it?
Are the members predominantly persons, or is this actually an OrganizationalCollaboration whose members are organizations?
What policy exception or agreement allows cross-organization membership when the default is single-organization membership?
What is the parent team, if any, and does this team have exactly one parent as in GitHub or an open unit hierarchy as in ORG?
Which child teams exist, and do their members count as inherited members of this team for listing, mentions or permissions?
Is nesting forbidden because this is a Scrum Team, a secret team, or another profile that rejects sub-teams?
When size or complexity requires change, should the team split into sibling teams sharing a goal rather than adding a child team?
Is this team recognized only inside a containing organization, matching OrganizationalUnit, or does it have standing of its own?
Are the primary members persons and other agents, or organizations playing roles in a venture?
Should this record be reclassified to OrganizationalCollaboration or Project rather than remaining a Team?
What non-containment links to other organizations exist, such as funding or supply relationships that must not be mistaken for unit hierarchy?
Who are the direct members of the team, and what agent kind is each: person, organization, nested team, guest or other?
Which participants are known only by role because the person is not yet assigned, as in a draft care team?
Are guests, patients, family members or other non-organization members allowed, or does policy require organization membership?
If a member is itself a Group or CareTeam, is membership flattened for operations, or kept as a nested agent?
Over what interval is each membership valid, recording start and end as RFC 3339 date-times with offset or Z?
What is the membership state, such as active, pending invitation, inherited or ended?
When is the member generally available to this team, if coverage is a repeating timing rather than a single period?
For this membership change, what was the event time versus the observation or ingestion time?
Which invitations to join the team are pending, who invited them, and when were the invitations created?
Is membership synchronized from an identity-provider group, and does that block local add or remove operations?
Is membership computed from a directory rule, and is processing on or paused?
Who may add or remove members when local writes are allowed: organization owner, team maintainer, team owner or another role?
Which posts or positions exist on this team, including vacant posts that currently have no holder?
Who currently holds each post, and may a post be held by more than one person at once?
What is the assignment interval for each holder, with RFC 3339 start and end?
Is the agent a member of the team ex officio because they hold a post, rather than by personal appointment?
What role, accountability or participation type does each member hold on this team?
Who is the formal head, product owner, Scrum Master, team owner, maintainer or coach, and is that a unique seat?
If this is a Scrum Team, are the three accountabilities present, and is internal hierarchy asserted despite the Guide forbidding it?
What reporting line exists among members, if any, and does it conflict with a self-managing profile?
What is the current operational status of the team, and which status system is being used?
Is the team archived read-only, limited to owners, or in migration mode, and who may still write?
Which status transitions are allowed from the current state, including unarchive, reactivate or entered-in-error correction?
Does this status act as a modifier, as FHIR status does, so that other fields must be interpreted differently?
What period is the team intended to cover, with RFC 3339 start and end distinct from created and last-modified timestamps?
When was the team founded or dissolved, if those civic or sporting dates apply in addition to operational period?
What change events created, merged, split or restructured this team, and which original and resulting team identities are linked?
Did the team keep its identifier through the change, or was a new URI required because the result is a distinct organization?
Is the team archived, entered in error, or otherwise an end state that is not a clean dissolution?
Is the requested operation archive, unarchive, clone, mark entered-in-error, or irreversible delete of team and associated group?
After archive or delete, what retention period applies to the team record and membership history, and who is the retention authority?
Who is authorized to archive, unarchive, clone or delete the team?
What is the visibility or privacy class of the team, and which vocabulary is in use: GitHub secret or closed, GitHub visible or secret, or Microsoft Public or Private?
What sensitivity or business-data classification applies, and does it match a preconfigured directory label?
Who can discover, view or @mention the team, and does a mention of a secret team reveal its name?
What privacy duty applies when distributing membership lists across provisioning domains, as SCIM warns?
Which resources can the team access, at what permission level, and are those entitlements inherited by child teams?
What may ordinary members create, update or delete inside the team, such as channels, apps, tabs or connectors?
What may guests do, and how does that differ from member and owner capabilities?
What exception grants a person or child team broader access than the team default, and who authorized it?
Where is the team based, including primary site, home location, address or basedAt site?
What telephone, email or other contact points apply to the team as a whole rather than to individual members?
What shift or availability schedule exists for the team, if any?
Is the team virtual with no physical site, and if so how is location recorded without inventing a site?
Which system authored the current team record, at what created and last-modified times, and which version token applies?
What evidence, notes or annotations support the stated membership, purpose and status?
Which external types is this instance aligned to, and is any alignment claimed as conformance?
What quality issues are open, such as missing purpose, role-only draft members, IdP sync drift or conflicting hierarchy rules?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
